description: Controller.step sequences. Per case, build the controller with params.sensing.latencyMs = latencyMs, params.sensing.noise.enabled = noiseEnabled and Controller(seed). Per tick: meas = (pos, vel, q wxyz, wB), ref = (refPos, refYaw), gs, kT = kT_applied (pitch, roll). Outputs are CtrlOut fields; sensed* is the measurement used after noise and latency.
